threshold_provenance.pooled_oof_f2: provisional pooled window-F2 threshold selected on these same OOF labels; descriptive only and not an unbiased event-performance estimate

alarm_policy.false_alarm_rule: alarm episode overlaps no annotated seizure
alarm_policy.false_alarm_rate_denominator: exact recording duration minus union of clipped annotated seizure intervals

duration_source_audit.join_key: normalized relative_path, cross-checked against subject and edf_file

limitations: These are inner OOF development results, not outer-test performance.
The pooled OOF F2 threshold was selected using these same OOF labels; its event metrics are descriptive and optimistic for threshold selection.
Probabilities come from 22 different fold models; cross-fold calibration comparability has not yet been established.
No threshold or alarm policy was selected by this evaluator.
This academic research prototype is not a medical device and is not for diagnosis or treatment decisions.
